subject: [Redwood] Discovery recap & next steps / Should I close the file?

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir.shah@acme.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 14:25:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood discovery recap & next steps

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re aligned and can get your team a PoC running: 

- Goal: Evaluate Redwood for low-latency, multi-tenant inference of Acme’s customer support assistant (avg seq len ~180 tokens).
- Success metrics: 99th pct latency < 300ms for short chats, <$0.0008/token on steady-state traffic, and no PII leakage in user prompts.
- Technical asks: SOC 2 evidence, VPC/private deployment option, and an eval dataset (10-20 sample conversations) to validate quality.

Agreed next steps:
1) I’ll send our pricing + config options (attached).
2) Alex will share a short checklist for SOC2/segregation requirements.
3) Samir / Priya to share procurement timeline and eval dataset.
4) If procurement timing looks good, we’ll schedule a 2-week PoC kickoff the week of Jul 6.

Attachments: redwood-pricing.pdf (pricing + Dedicated config)

If anything above is off, flag it — otherwise I’ll expect the dataset and timeline from your side. I’m free for a quick sync if it helps: https://calendly.com/marissa-redwood/30min

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Hey Marissa —

Thanks for the recap, looks right to me. Couple quick items: 

- Can you confirm target concurrency for the Dedicated config? We typically need 200 concurrent users during peak.
- Our security lead (Priya) will want the SOC2 report and any data flow diagrams. Priya — looping you in.

Procurement is likely to start the first week of July; I’ll confirm by end of next week. I’ll also try to share a sample of the eval data (redacted) by Jun 19.
